report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unsupported. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200/ok. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. Deployment record only proves version 1.0.0 with no prior version. No current evidence establishes any bounded cause; logs were excluded.
missing_evidence: Logs for order/checkout services (ev-...-r0-logs-order excluded) to identify any error signatures
Error-rate or 5xx metrics across checkout, payment, inventory services beyond order
Deployment timeline correlating version changes with any observed error onset
Confirmation of whether checkout errors are actually occurring in current telemetry
